scope: Internal protocol inheriting the previously fixed photon split, before the parent runs the129Ba IBFM case; not external preregistration, blinded model-class selection, or original-PBOS replay.

hamiltonian_inputs.core_and_count_status: source-supported inference and conventional even-core valence counting; actual author run card unavailable
hamiltonian_inputs.fermion_sp_energy: common shift omitted in this fixed single-j block
hamiltonian_inputs.Q_jj: signed reduced angular Y2 matrix element for h11/2, standard Condon-Shortley convention; validate independently before numerical use

EM_inputs.e_B: positive value fixed only by core B(E2;2_1->0) and the computed core unit strength

core_calibration.source_locator: 128Ba adopted ENSDF L17-18,48-53; sole pure-E2 branch
core_calibration.boundary: central derived calibration; not a new measurement or an independent datum in addition to its half-life/BE2W

scale_protocol: Use same153.8/518.6anchor and5withheldpairs. For inter-spin M1 the gB*J term vanishes. Normalize odd E2 strengths by e_B² and use particle-j unit B, so the same r=a+eta*b equation applies. eta>=0 represents the unknown common magnetic scale; no unreported g_B is invented.
invalid_anchor_rule: negative eta means central-anchor failure; do not silently clip
state_mapping: same ten source-specific levels and predeclared per-spin ordinals as energy-fit-contract.json; report energy discrepancy before EM, no state changes selected by EM
no_refit: Published Hamiltonian constants remain frozen; no odd energy or photon data adjusted in this reconstruction. Report unknown original calibration-level selection.
excluded_shortcuts: Do not substitute130Ba/NB7 while retaining the particle/operator interpretation unchanged.
Do not infer individual RME from published shape invariants.
Do not convert raw signs, normal ordering, or effective-charge units to match a desired curve.
Do not treat this numerical reconstruction as a new experiment or established collective mode.
model_selection_boundary: The IBFM comparator is being investigated after viewing the earlier rigid-rotor predictions. Withheld means omitted from this parameter/scale calibration, not unseen during the overall research process.
